description_en: Lists the data sources in a FeatureStore instance. You can filter the results by workspace, type, and name
description_zh: 列出 FeatureStore 实例下的数据源，支持按工作空间、类型和名称过滤
name: ListDatasources

parameters.help_en: The ID of the FeatureStore instance. Call the ListInstances operation to get the instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html operation to get the workspace ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

Hologres

Redis

MaxCompute
parameters.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值如下：

Hologres
Redis
MaxCompute
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en: The name of the data source
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The number of data sources per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，起始值为1，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:

Asc: ascending order.

Desc: descending order
parameters.help_zh:
排序方式，取值如下：

Asc - 升序排列。

Desc - 降序排列
parameters.name: order

Config.title_en: The type-specific configuration (JSON string). Keys vary by Type: MaxCompute/TableStore — not used; Hologres — may contain `vpc_id`, `vswitch_id`; FeatureDB — may contain `username`, `password`, `vpc_id`, `vswitch_ids`.
Config.title_zh: The type-specific configuration (JSON string). Keys vary by Type: MaxCompute/TableStore — not used; Hologres — may contain `vpc_id`, `vswitch_id`; FeatureDB — may contain `username`, `password`, `vpc_id`, `vswitch_ids`.
